text:
mike_ae: Quick heads-up 5 min sync: ratecard update touching EDU/academic POC discounts. Need deal-desk signoff and a short internal note for AEs.
karina_salesops: what changed exactly?
mike_ae: We tightened the EDU POC cap and reduced the lead-time discount for non-commits. Snippet: 
```
- edu_poc_discount: 25
+ edu_poc_discount: 18
  max_tokens_per_month: 5_000_000
  grace_period_days: 14
  effective_date: "2025-10-15"
```
lucy_dealdesk: Oof. That's a notable drop. Are we grandfathering current EDU trials started before effective_date?
mike_ae: Proposal: grandfather active trials until signed contract or until their grace period ends (whichever comes later).
tom_fin: Finance note: No rebilling. Revenue recognition unaffected. We should document the fiscal impact if many convert at old rates vs new. I'll compile a 1-pager.
hana_legal: No red flags on policy. We should add a short line to the EDU addendum templates clarifying eligibility and data-use limits.
karina_salesops: Does this affect any live quotes in the pipeline? I can query SFDC and tag opportunities.
lucy_dealdesk: Please tag anything >$50k ARR. We will fast-track exceptions for strategic accounts.
ratecard-bot: New PR opened for ratecard v3.3.0: https://redwood.internal/ratecard/pr/4123 (edu_poc_discount change). Reviewers requested: @lucy_dealdesk, @tom_fin, @hana_legal.
lucy_dealdesk: Reviewing now. :eyes:
tom_fin: Approving pending the 1-pager. :+1:
hana_legal: Approved.
lucy_dealdesk: Approved and setting exception workflow: field reps submit deal link + justification. We'll respond within 24 hours.
karina_salesops: I'll publish a short internal FAQ and update the quoting quick-template. ETA 3 hours.
mike_ae: Can someone ping the partner AEs doing academic partnerships? They run a lot of EDU POCs.
karina_salesops: On it. I'll send a mention in #sales-partners and DM the top three owners.
lucy_dealdesk: Reminder: exceptions for research labs require CTO approval and an institutional billing contact.
mike_ae: Thanks everyone. Keeping this tight — it's a pricing tweak but high-touch for the field. If any AE sees a churn risk, escalate to me and we'll consider an exception. :rocket:
